MATCH (c:Issue)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(p:Issue), (c)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(cp:Project), (p)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pp:Project), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person)
WHERE cp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND pp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND a.personKey <> ''
WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.personKey) AS ppl, collect(DISTINCT c.issueKey) AS kids
WHERE size(ppl)>=2
RETURN p.issueKey AS id, kids, ppl

MATCH (c:Issue)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(p:Issue), (c)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(cp:Project), (p)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pp:Project), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person)
WHERE cp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND pp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND a.personKey <> ''
WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.personKey) AS ppl, collect(DISTINCT c) AS kids
WHERE size(ppl)>=2
UNWIND kids AS c
MATCH (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT p.issueKey AS id, c.issueKey AS child, a.personKey AS person

MATCH (c:Issue)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(p:Issue), (c)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(cp:Project), (p)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pp:Project), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person)
WHERE cp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND pp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND a.personKey <> ''
WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.personKey) AS ppl, collect(DISTINCT c) AS kids
WHERE size(ppl)>=2
UNWIND (kids+[p]) AS i
RETURN DISTINCT i.issueKey AS issue

MATCH (c:Issue)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(p:Issue), (c)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(cp:Project), (p)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pp:Project), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person)
WHERE cp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND pp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND a.personKey <> ''
WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.personKey) AS ppl
WHERE size(ppl)>=2
RETURN p.issueKey AS id
